_meta.notes: Vendor bench tables were parsed straight from Hugging Face README files and the Z.ai blog JS bundle, not retyped. Artificial Analysis numbers come from the model-page data (v5.0.1). Vals numbers from the Vals Index v2.2 and Terminal-Bench 4.0 leaderboards (both updated 2026-11-19). Blocked during research: z.ai/blog pages via WebFetch (read through the JS bundle instead), arena.ai and lmarena.ai raw pages (Cloudflare), Kimi K3 tech report PDF on GitHub.

notes.zh: 6 月以来：V4-Flash-0731（7/31，已下线）→ V4-Pro-0813（8/13 正式版）→ V4-Flash-Vision-Exp（8 月，已下线）→ V4.1-Flash（9/10）→ V4.1-Flash-1017（10/17，现役，API 名 deepseek-flash）。V4.1-Pro 已预告但没有日期。11/13 起 API 内置联网搜索、读链接、文件输入。全部权重 MIT。V4-Pro 的下线通知 9 月里反复两次，官方价格页现在仍列着 deepseek-v4-pro。
notes.en: Since June: V4-Flash-0731 (Jul 31, retired) → V4-Pro-0813 (Aug 13, GA) → V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (Aug, retired) → V4.1-Flash (Sep 10) → V4.1-Flash-1017 (Oct 17, current; API name deepseek-flash). V4.1-Pro is announced without a date. Since Nov 13 the API has built-in web search, URL reading and file input. All weights are MIT. The V4-Pro retirement notice flip-flopped twice in September; the official pricing page still lists deepseek-v4-pro.

notes.zh: 6 月以来：K2.7 Code（6/12）→ K3（7/16，权重 7/27）→ K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro Highspeed（10/24，权重约 11/4）。K3 起改用自定义许可证（不再叫「修改版 MIT」），收入超 2000 万美元的 MaaS 要另签协议。K2 系列 10/31 起不对新用户开放，年底下线。
notes.en: Since June: K2.7 Code (Jun 12) → K3 (Jul 16, weights Jul 27) → K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed (Oct 24, weights ~Nov 4). From K3 on, weights ship under a custom license (no longer "modified MIT"); MaaS businesses above $20M revenue need a separate agreement. K2 models are closed to new users since Oct 31 and retire at year end.

notes.zh: 6 月以来：GLM-5.2（6/16，MIT）→ GLM-5.3（8/14 宣布、8/18 API、权重晚两周，改用带安全审查条款的 GLM-5.3 License）→ GLM-5.3-Flash / FlashX（8/26，MIT）。截至 11/22 没有更新的正式发布；GLM-5.5 / GLM-6 只有传闻。
notes.en: Since June: GLM-5.2 (Jun 16, MIT) → GLM-5.3 (announced Aug 14, API Aug 18, weights two weeks later under the new GLM-5.3 License with a security-review clause) → GLM-5.3-Flash / FlashX (Aug 26, MIT). No newer official release as of Nov 22; GLM-5.5 and GLM-6 are rumors only.

models.summary_zh: V4.1 新架构的首个也是最小的型号：552B 主干、因果编码器-解码器，预填充只激活 8B、解码 16B，KV 缓存降到 V4-Flash 的约 1/4，并原生看图。按 DeepSeek 自己的表，它在多数智能体和编码测试上超过上一代旗舰 V4-Pro。
models.summary_en: The first and smallest model on the new V4.1 architecture: a 552B causal encoder-decoder that activates 8B parameters to read and 16B to write, with a KV cache about a quarter the size of V4-Flash and native vision. On DeepSeek's own table it beats the older V4-Pro flagship on most agentic and coding tests.

models.summary_zh: 智谱现役旗舰，和 GLM-5.2 同一个底座，全部提升来自后训练：编码明显变强（Terminal-Bench 3.0 4.6→28.3，DeepSWE 46.2→66.9），网络安全能力意外暴涨，CyberGym 84.5 超过 Mythos 5。权重晚两周放出，并改用带安全审查条款的自定义许可证。
models.summary_en: Zhipu's current flagship, built on GLM-5.2's base with all gains from post-training. Coding is much stronger (Terminal-Bench 3.0 4.6 → 28.3, DeepSWE 46.2 → 66.9), and cyber skills jumped unexpectedly, with CyberGym at 84.5, ahead of Mythos 5. Weights came two weeks late under a new custom license with a security-review clause.

models.summary_zh: GLM-5 系列第一个原生多模态型号，全新训练的底座，首次在 GLM 里混用线性注意力和稀疏注意力，注意力计算比 GLM-5.3 少约 3 倍。以十分之一的价格全面超过 GLM-5.2，编码和智能体接近 Claude Opus 4.8，而且整套服务跑在国产芯片上。
models.summary_en: The first natively multimodal GLM-5 model, on a freshly trained base that mixes linear and sparse attention for the first time in the series, cutting attention compute about 3× against GLM-5.3. It beats GLM-5.2 across the board at a tenth of the price, gets close to Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic tests, and is served entirely on Chinese chips.

models.summary_zh: 智谱 6 月旗舰，主打真正能用的 1M 上下文和长程任务；IndexShare 让 1M 长度下每个 token 的计算量降到约 1/2.9。相对 GLM-5.1，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 63.5 升到 81.0，DeepSWE 从 18 升到 46.2。
models.summary_en: Zhipu's June flagship, built around a 1M context that holds up over long tasks; IndexShare cuts per-token compute at 1M length by about 2.9×. Against GLM-5.1, Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises from 63.5 to 81.0 and DeepSWE from 18 to 46.2.
